name: Gamble EOS
rootCause: The attacker launched a continuous attack on the EOS quiz game Gamble EOS, successfully profited thousands of EOS, and has been transferred to the Huobi exchange. After analysis, it was found that the attack method used by the attacker was a false transfer notification.
